triage.verifier_notes:
Runner-up kind is unrepresented_clause: one can read the fix as finally representing the (aa)(ii) exclusion list and the §232-covered carve-out (in ch02 the old branch could never be true, so those exceptions were effectively absent). I kept wrong_entity_or_scope because the exception branch already existed and only its covered population changed, and because the same diff corrects three other components the same way (Brazil-301 and forced-labor-301 previously applied by origin alone with no list-membership test; China-301 slots moved from exemplar identity to entry_is_china_301_list123 / list4a).

Caveats a reviewer should know: (1) the same diff also ADDS `section_232_steel_component_rate` + `ch02_s232_steel_heading_rate` and wires steel into `schedule_statutory_stack`; the PR says the witness "never had" a steel slot, so that half of the diff is new coverage the module never claimed and is NOT a defect — the defect must be anchored on the §122/§301/Brazil/forced-labor gate lines, which is what the candidate's rule_path does. (2) The source text could not be independently verified through the pinned release: `resolve_provision.py --rulespec-commit a9562cfd44` selects release us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap (HTS 2026 Rev. 3 notes), where chapter-99/page-221 resolves to note subdivisions (x)-(z) on heading 9903.01.77 and page-230 to §232 steel quota notes — neither contains the §122 (aa)(ii) text or the 9903.82.02/.04 excerpt the atoms quote (page drift across revisions). The kind therefore rests on the diff, the unchanged proof atoms, the entry-flag tool, and the PR body, not on resolver-confirmed provision text. (3) Minor, unrelated to the verdict: the new `section_232_steel_component_rate` block in this commit carries a double-nested `metadata.proof.proof.atoms`; the PR issue comment records that being unwrapped in a later repair round, so this commit is the pre-repair state.

Candidate's supporting quote is verbatim from the PR body; I verified the substring "unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins" appears there.
